data.summary: Physiotherapie Beispielbalance billed Anton Musterschmidt €301.30 for private physiotherapy treatments given between 22 April and 20 May 2025 (invoice PB-0525-117, dated 23 May 2025), payable within 30 days of the invoice date.
data.explanation: This is a private invoice (not covered by statutory health insurance) for physiotherapy sessions, heat-pack treatments and a report sent to the prescribing doctor. You should transfer €301.30 to the practice's account, quoting the invoice number PB-0525-117, by the deadline shown (30 days after the invoice date). There is no mention of what happens if you miss it, but late payment can lead to a reminder. Keep this invoice, as such medical costs may be deductible in your tax return — a tax advisor can confirm if this applies to you.
